    Frequently Asked Questions

    Everything you need to know about building, scaling, and optimizing your eCommerce store.

    💡 We focus on performance, conversions, and long-term growth — not just design.
    What platform is best for my eCommerce store? +

    It depends on your business size, product range, and scalability needs. Shopify works great for fast-growing brands, while Magento and headless solutions are ideal for complex, high-scale businesses.

    How long does eCommerce development take? +

    Basic stores typically take 4–8 weeks, while advanced or enterprise-level platforms may take longer depending on integrations, features, and complexity.

    Do you provide post-launch support? +

    Yes. We provide ongoing support, maintenance, optimization, and marketing assistance to ensure your store continues to grow after launch.

    Can you migrate my existing store? +

    Absolutely. We handle seamless migrations from platforms like WooCommerce, Magento, or custom builds — ensuring minimal downtime and zero data loss.

    Will my store be mobile-friendly? +

    Yes. Every store we build is fully responsive and optimized for mobile-first users, ensuring seamless browsing and checkout experiences.

    Do you help with SEO and marketing? +

    Yes. We implement SEO foundations, analytics tracking, and marketing strategies including email automation, retargeting, and conversion optimization.
